brief:
The Gaza Health Ministry documented seven deaths and thirty injuries across sector hospitals during the previous 24 hours, the Shehab Wire reported. Officials attributed the casualties to the continuing consequences of Israeli military operations in the territory.

The ministry's announcement provided no further specifics regarding the circumstances of individual incidents or the geographical distribution of casualties among Gaza's medical facilities. Health officials have maintained ongoing casualty counts as military operations persist in the densely populated coastal enclave.
